author: Sp4rrkii
body:
So i have been making maps for avicus for a considerable amount of time and i really enjoy it! Although i 'm producing a few maps now, i think soon my motivation will be lost. This is where the Builder rank comes in. I think that this rank will give me a boost to help make more maps for avicus, and it will also mean i will be able to make more maps faster, with the other builders. 
Hopefully you see this as a good opportunity to bring in a new map maker, as i dont feel enough are being made.
Kind regards,
Sk33nDhu

If you need to contact me privately email me on - sk33ndhu@gmail.com

Hello Sk33nDhu,

You did not use the correct format for the application. This application is denied, but you may submit a new one using the correct format, with no penalties incurred. The application format is located in the following thread: https://avicus.net/forums/discussions/91e44537d

Thank you.
